audit_items.proof_trace: is_obligation_safe correctly computes collateral_weighted_value = Σ(collateral_usd * collateral_factor) and borrow_weight_weighted_debt_value = Σ(debt_usd * borrow_weight), returning collateral_weighted >= debt_weighted. This check is called after every borrow (L424-434) and every collateral withdrawal (L332-342), reverting the transaction on failure. Emode param creation/update enforces borrow_weight >= 1.0 and collateral_factor < 1.0 via create_emode_params_inner (emode_admin.move:175-178), and new_emode_params is called without validation only from test-only code.
